findings.title: `queued` is fixed at module import time
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when this module is imported, so every `AssignmentSource` created afterward receives the same timestamp rather than its creation/queue time. The field therefore cannot identify when a particular assignment was queued, and its value may be arbitrarily stale in long-lived workers. Use a `default_factory` so the timestamp is generated for each instance.
